boundaries: The caret confirms canonical identity resolution for the stated context only.
No caret proves conduct, role on a date, knowledge, intent, relationship, liability, current status, procedural outcome or source authenticity.
No unresolved object is marked merely to reach 100 percent coverage.
Concepts, assets, events, documents, source aliases and generic roles remain outside the eligible denominator.
post_merge_requirements: Confirm the merge SHA on main.
Confirm successful GitHub Pages deployment for that SHA.
Read back both bilingual routes and their linked CAEPR anchors.
Promote the manifest only after exact public verification.
